profile.summary:
Enthusiastic Software Developer. 
Eager to deepen my knowledge in tech related fields.

Skill: Angular, Spring, Git, Microservices, Cypress Tests

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Assist in developing cloud base applications (Financials, Services, etc.) with Angular and Spring Boot microservices
- Deliver clean solutions in helping and maintaning company platform

positions.title: CS Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Prepare and assist Prof. Darren Seifert in UNIV class in class organization and activities for freshmen.

positions.title: Mathematics/ CS Tutor
positions.description:
Prepared aids explaining technical Computer Science and Mathematics related questions from students.
Reinforced Computer Science concept to students from their classes.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Novel work pioneering formula for the transmission rate and recovery rate using
integration with Dr. Bishnu Sedai.
�Collected public data (2020–2022) from North Dakota Department of Health for

positions.title: Mathematics Laboratory Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
TA in Intermediate Algebra, College Algebra, Elementary Statistic (Prof Timothy Morris, Prof Jennifer Sherman, Dr Bishnu Sedai) in Lab Section
Supervising and assisting for students during their homework hours.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
MaterialsBase JS (React, NodeJS, ExpressJS, SequelizeORM) Full-Stack web app for bioinformatics purpose.
Research and design machine learning model to predict the drug-like and toxicological properties of Fullerene targeting on diabetes proteins using Python and R.

positions.title: Peer Mentor at ASTEP
positions.description: Support students with intellectual and developmental disabilities in their academic class, social skills, etc.

positions.title: Personalized One on One Tutor
positions.description: 1 on 1 tutor for high school student to prepare for University Entrance Exam in science course such as Math (Calculus, Algebra, Geometry,etc), Physics, Chemistry.
